WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
bystore AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) ns
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT r.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) cs
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(b.store_id,c.store_id) sid, COALESCE(b.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, b.ns, c.cs, round(b.ns-c.cs,2) diff
FROM bystore b FULL JOIN ctl c ON b.store_id=c.store_id AND b.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year
WHERE b.ns IS NULL OR c.cs IS NULL OR abs(b.ns-c.cs)>0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_region AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, ty.region,
       ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM by_region ty
JOIN by_region ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.region

SELECT d.fiscal_year, s.store_id=999 AS is999, p.category='ZZ Test' AS is_test, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
